question: Which public live rooms actually satisfy the video-only MediaStream admission that documentOutput requires, and why did the existing live smoke case fail on them?
head: 0b907ee0

artifact.note: The rebuild hashes are byte-identical to the 11-11 workspace build recorded in 2026-11-14-local-document-output-built-extension-proof.json, so the earlier local rounds and these real-site rounds ran the same shipped source.

method: Load the rebuilt production extension into real Chrome; open public HTTPS rooms; observe every frame's video/audio elements, srcObject track inventory, duration, playback state and IntersectionObserver geometry. The shape survey used no extension control; the control diagnostics are archived separately.

huya.concurrentElement: a finite silent pre-roll video (mp4, volume=0, duration about 35s, bounding area 20628 vs 406406 for the broadcast)
huya.note: After the pre-roll leaves the DOM only the broadcast remains.

douyinLiveRooms.mainVideo: MediaStream with videoTracks=1 and audioTracks=1 on all three rooms; duration=Infinity; playing; currentTime>25
douyinLiveRooms.note: The stream carries its own audio track, so nativeAudioAbsent is not proved and the native element route is the correct owner.

douyinWww.result: captcha interstitial (verifycenter iframe); no media element observed
douyinWww.note: This station could not be sampled in this run. Historical 11-04 page_native confirmation remains the only evidence for www.douyin.com and does not describe the current HEAD.

viewportRootCause.consequence: With every recorded visibleArea at zero, mediaRank's live-priority term (visibleArea > 0 && isLiveMedia) cannot fire and selection falls through to registration order, so a late silent pre-roll can win. At 1600x1200 the broadcast is admitted immediately.
viewportRootCause.testChange: test/smoke/document-output.spec.ts now sizes the viewport to 1600x1200 and requires the broadcast to be inside the viewport before driving the slider.

summary: Huya 102411 is the real-site case that exercises documentOutput. Douyin live rooms carry an audio track and correctly stay on the native element route. www.douyin.com was blocked by a captcha and is explicitly out of scope for this run. The earlier live-case failure was a test viewport artefact, not a product regression.
notEvidenceFor: Any behaviour on www.douyin.com in the current HEAD build
That the same room always has the same stream shape at a later date
That a viewer with a different window size or scroll position sees identical geometry
That the site UI follows the extension on Huya (not sampled there)
